# Combat Next Steps Plan

## Confirmed Behavior
- Use current `5x5` logical grid; make the **visual grid area** 50% larger and window-responsive.
- Treat each `Spin` as the buy action: deduct current bet on spin start, then add resolved round winnings.

## Implementation Steps
- Update layout in [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn) and [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn) so the grid container is anchored/scaled from viewport size and renders at ~150% of current size.
- Replace fixed-size assumptions in [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd) (notably cell-size based FX offsets) with slot-size derived values so animation remains correct when the grid is visually larger.
- Add a `Round Winnings` readout below the grid in [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn), and wire it in [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd) to increment after each symbol-match payout event during cascade resolution.
- Remove `New Grid` control from [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn) and its handler from [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd); keep `Spin` as the only entrypoint that generates a new seed/new round.
- Add bankroll state to [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd): initialize `10,000` fake currency, deduct `current bet` when spin starts (with insufficient-funds guard), and credit final round payout at round completion.
- Expose bankroll and round winnings in test HUD via [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd), refreshing through existing readout signals.
- Update deterministic/combat checks if needed in [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/determinism_check.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/determinism_check.gd) and [`c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/princess_check.gd`](c:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/princess_check.gd) so they reflect the new readouts/economy side effects.

## Data Flow (Planned)
```mermaid
flowchart TD
spinPress[SpinPressed] --> debit[DebitCurrentBet]
spinPress --> seed[GenerateNewSeed]
seed --> cascade[ResolveCascades]
cascade --> matchWin[SymbolMatchWin]
matchWin --> roundTotal[UpdateRoundWinningsLabel]
cascade --> roundEnd[RoundCompletePayout]
roundEnd --> credit[CreditBankroll]
credit --> hud[RefreshHUD]
```

## Validation
- Verify grid visually scales to ~150% at common window sizes and stays positioned correctly.
- Verify `Round Winnings` starts at zero each spin and increments after each winning match/cascade.
- Verify no `New Grid` button is present and repeated `Spin` always starts a fresh seeded round.
- Verify bankroll starts at `10,000`, decreases by bet per spin, increases by round payout, and blocks spin when insufficient funds.

Implemented all plan todos without touching the plan file.

### What changed

- `combat` grid is now window-responsive and scaled up visually (~150%) while staying `5x5`.
  - Added viewport-fit layout method in `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`.
  - Hooked resize/layout updates from `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`.
- Added a live **Round Winnings** readout below the grid.
  - UI node added in `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`.
  - Round winnings state + updates added in `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`.
  - It increments after each symbol-match payout event (cascade/trinity win steps), not just at round end.
- Removed **New Grid** flow so **Spin** is the only entrypoint.
  - Removed `NewGridButton` from `AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`.
  - Removed button wiring/handler from `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`.
- Added fake bankroll loop (`10,000` start).
  - Bankroll tracked in cents in `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`.
  - On each spin: deduct current bet at spin start.
  - On round complete: add resolved payout.
  - Added affordability guard so spin is blocked if bankroll is too low.
  - Exposed bankroll to HUD via `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd` and added `BankrollLabel` in `AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`.
- Removed hardcoded slot count (`25`) in slot creation; now uses `ROWS * COLS`.

### Validation done

- Lint pass on edited scripts:
  - `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`
  - `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`
- Verified `NewGridButton`/`_on_new_grid` references are gone.
- Verified new symbols/functions exist (`fit_to_viewport`, bankroll getters, round winnings label wiring).

### Note

- I only changed the four planned combat files:
  - `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`
  - `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`
  - `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`
  - `AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`

If you want, I can next run a quick gameplay pass checklist in-editor (resize window, spin loop, low-bankroll block) and tune the visual scale constants if the grid feels too large/small on your monitor.
